verified_statements: Delta G_UH is the partition-function folding energy for the pET21 5'UTR plus the first 48 nt of the CDS.
The optimized-construct p025, p50 and p975 columns are model prediction quantiles rather than measured expression labels.
The 6,348-expression dataset is cross-protein and non-synonymous.
